rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.03 is extremely compressed, indicating the instrument is effectively in a standstill — the last five candles span roughly a 5-cent range, offering negligible profit potential relative to any stop placement. While price is below both session and 5-minute VWAP (bearish lean) and the open-to-current represents a significant fade from the gap-up open, the tight consolidation provides no directional trigger in either direction with 72 minutes remaining. Without a breakout or breakdown from this compression, and with no news catalyst, there is insufficient mechanical edge to justify entry.
